item.title: Bringing Indian Cuisine to Swiss Altitude: A Catering Playbook
item.description: How we serve Indian regional menus, Jain and halal tables and Swiss fine dining at alpine venues: menu governance, dietary law in practice, kitchen logistics and the tasting protocol that locks a menu before anyone travels.

item.title: The 180-Day Davos Delegation Countdown
item.description: A working checklist by month, from accommodation strategy at 180 days to the 24-hour rhythm of Week 0, drawn from four consecutive Davos Weeks on the ground in Davos.
